entries.name: Tierärztekammer Berlin – Notdienst (Übersicht Notdienstkliniken und -praxen)
entries.duty: Chamber page listing Berlin clinics/practices with 24-h small-animal emergency service and practices with evening/weekend/holiday emergency hours; advises searching 'Notdienst, Tierarzt, Berlin, Stadtbezirk' and using clinics only for life-threatening cases
entries.note: No central emergency phone; chamber office number is administrative only. Clinics report severe capacity shortages.

entries.name: Tierärztekammer Hamburg – aktueller Notdienstplan
entries.duty: Rota of the practice on duty: Mon–Fri 20:00–08:00, weekends and holidays 08:00–08:00 next day; information line 040 434379; always call the practice first
entries.note: Emergency surcharge 50 EUR + VAT under GOT.

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst der Stadt Bremen (Tierärztekammer Bremen)
entries.duty: Mon–Fri 18:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 08:00–22:00; phone registration mandatory. Outside these hours the page refers to surrounding clinics (Posthausen, Sottrum, TiHo Hannover)

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notfalldienst für Kleintiere Sachsen (zentrale Notrufnummer)
entries.duty: Since 1 Jan 2025: Mon–Fri 18:00–08:00 and all day on weekends and holidays; caller is connected directly to the nearest on-duty practice (chosen by caller location). Small animals only, usually no house visits
entries.quote: Montag – Freitag 18:00 – 08:00 Uhr und ganztägig am Wochenende und an den Feiertagen
entries.note: Sächsische Landestierärztekammer announcement. 01805 is a charged service number. vetnotdienst.de could not be fetched (not reachable from this tool).

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Brandenburg (zentrale Notdienstnummer)
entries.duty: Mon–Thu 18:00–08:00, Fri 18:00 to Mon 08:00, public holidays 0–24; call ahead
entries.quote: Die Brandenburg-weite Notdienstnummer ist die 01805843736.
entries.note: Stated on a participating practice's page; AniCura Potsdam's page also names 'Tierärztlicher Notdienstring Berlin-Brandenburg' 01805 84 37 36. LTK Brandenburg page on the new emergency model could not be fetched (2 tries).

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (landesweite Notdienstnummer)
entries.duty: Statewide number that connects to the nearest on-duty practice in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
entries.note: Stated on Tierklinik Rostock's emergency page; Tierarztpraxis Puvogel (Rügen) and Tierarztpraxis Maack (Usedom) also refer small-animal emergencies to 01805 84 37 36. No chamber page found.

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Schleswig-Holstein (Tierärztekammer, zentrale Nummer)
entries.duty: Central number connects to the nearest on-duty vet; announce the emergency before arriving
entries.quote: Seit 2022 wird der 24-stündige tierärztliche Notdienst zentral von der Tierärztekammer Schleswig-Holstein organisiert.
entries.note: Same number on Tiermedizin am Kurpark (heading '24-Stunden-Notdienst Schleswig-Holstein:'), Tierklinik Neustädter Bucht and fehmarn.de. Chamber's own Kleintiernotdienst page redirected to a login area and could not be read.

entries.name: Zentraler Tierärztlicher Notdienst für Klein- und Heimtiere in Sachsen-Anhalt
entries.duty: Online search for the on-duty vet; weeknights 18:00–08:00, Fri 18:00 to Mon 08:00, holidays all day; announce the emergency to the duty vet by phone
entries.quote: Der Notfall ist dem diensthabenden Tierarzt/ der diensthabenden Tierärztin vorab telefonisch anzukündigen.
entries.note: Tierärztekammer Sachsen-Anhalt flyer and homepage link to tieraerztliche-notdienste.de ('Notdienstsuche für Tierhalter in Sachsen-Anhalt'). No central phone.

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Thüringen (Telefonnummer der diensthabenden Tierärzte)
entries.duty: Line giving the on-duty vets in Thuringia outside practice hours
entries.quote: diensthabenden Tierärzte in Thüringen 24 h
entries.note: Number as printed on Tierärztliche Klinik Erfurt's contact page. Thüringer Landtag answer (Drs. 'Tierärztlicher Notdienst in Thüringen erneut nachgefragt') describes regional Notdienstringe with central call handling at the Kassenärztliche Vereinigung Thüringen. Landestierärztekammer site (ltkt.de) could not be fetched.

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Hannover
entries.duty: Hannover practices' emergency rota; TiHo refers non-critical cases here and to local Ringnotdienste elsewhere
entries.note: URL taken from TiHo's emergency page; the rota site itself redirected in a loop and could not be read. Langenhagen practice page names an answering machine for the Hannover emergency service: 0511 65 51 18 21.

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Burgwedel, Isernhagen, Langenhagen, Wedemark
entries.duty: Dated rota Jan 2026–Jan 2027: weekdays 07:00 to 07:00 next morning, weekends Sat 12:00 to Mon 07:00; 'ohne Gewähr' – call first
entries.note: Hosted by a participating practice.

entries.name: Kleintiernotdienst Stadt Oldenburg (Ringnotdienst)
entries.duty: Joint rota of Oldenburg city practices for nights, weekends and holidays; see 'Dienstplan'; call the duty practice before going; no house visits
entries.note: Life-threatening emergencies only; emergency fee 50 EUR + VAT.

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Osnabrücker- & Tecklenburger Land
entries.duty: Mobile emergency practice for Osnabrück city and surrounding municipalities (Bad Iburg, Belm, Bissendorf, Bramsche, Georgsmarienhütte, Wallenhorst …) and the Tecklenburger Land; phone registration required
entries.quote: 365 Tage im Jahr - 24 Stunden am Tag
entries.note: Tecklenburger Land part lies in NRW. Operator not named on the page.

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Kleintiere Cuxland / Bremerhaven
entries.duty: Landkreis Cuxhaven and Bremerhaven, around the clock on call; contact the Notdienstgruppe of your own vet (group 1: 04744 4563999; group 2: 09001 144244, charged; group 3: online rota; group 4: own vet's answering machine). No house visits
entries.note: Backup named on the page: Tierklinik Posthausen and Klinik für Kleintiere Sottrum. Bremerhaven belongs to the Land Bremen.

entries.name: Tierärztlicher Notdienst Göttingen, Duderstadt, Hann. Münden
entries.duty: Dated rota of the duty practice: weekdays 20:00–08:00, Sat 12:00 to Mon 08:00, holidays 08:00–08:00; always phone ahead
entries.quote: Melden Sie Ihren Besuch immer telefonisch an, die Praxen sind nicht dauerhaft besetzt.
entries.note: Page also lists TiHo Hannover small-animal clinic (24 h) and Tierklinik Kaufungen (Hessen, 24 h) as fallbacks.

entries.name: Klinik für Kleintiere – Stiftung Tierärztliche Hochschule Hannover (TiHo)
entries.duty: Critical and acutely life-threatening emergencies at any time; triage first, non-urgent cases may be referred to a Ringnotdienst
entries.quote: Kritische und akut lebensbedrohliche Notfälle versorgen wir jederzeit – rund um die Uhr
entries.note: University small-animal hospital. Phone from tiho-hannover.de/kontakt (Klinik für Kleintiere, Notdienst); exotic pets: Klinik für Heimtiere, Reptilien, Zier- und Wildvögel +49 511 953-6800 (hannover.de).

entries.name: Klein- und Heimtierklinik – Freie Universität Berlin (Campus Düppel)
entries.duty: Emergencies Mon–Fri 8–18, weekends and holidays 10–18; outside these hours only after phone registration (+49 160 37 58 447)
entries.note: University hospital; ended its 24-h small-animal emergency care 'bis auf Weiteres' in May 2022 (FU press release). 24-h service exists only for Berlin wildlife.

entries.name: Klinik für Klein- und Heimtiere Biesdorf
entries.quote: Tierkliniken oder Praxen mit 24 Stunden-Notdienst für Klein- und Heimtiere
entries.note: 24-h status from the Tierärztekammer Berlin list heading; no hours on the page.

entries.note: 24-h status from the Tierärztekammer Berlin list heading.

entries.note: 24-h status from the Tierärztekammer Berlin list heading.

entries.quote: 24/7 NOTDIENST

entries.name: AniCura Tierärztliche Klinik für Kleintiere Quickborn
entries.duty: Call ahead before coming in

entries.quote: Notdienst bei lebensbedrohlichen Notfällen auch nachts und an Wochenenden
entries.note: Not stated as 24 h. Weekend/emergency surcharges, cash only.

entries.duty: Emergency service after phone registration Mon–Fri 8–22, Sat/Sun/holidays 10–16; otherwise Sachsen central number 01805 84 37 36
entries.note: Dogs and cats.

entries.note: Former 24-h Tierklinik Potsdam site; page now states 8–20 only.

entries.quote: NOTDIENST: Mo-Fr 7-24 Uhr, Sa 11-13 und 19-21 Uhr, So 11-13 und 19-21 Uhr und an Feiertagen 11-13 und 19-21 Uhr.

entries.name: Sylter Tierarztpraxis
entries.duty: Mon/Tue/Thu 8–12 and 14–16, Wed/Fri 8–12; mobile 0151 46341056
entries.note: Small animals and pets ('Klein- und Heimtiere'). Island practice.

entries.name: Tierarztpraxis Kobilinski
entries.note: Island practice (surgery, ultrasound, X-ray). Hours and emergency info on sub-pages not read; small-animal focus not stated explicitly on the home page.

entries.duty: Mon–Fri 9:00–12:30 by appointment; afternoons and emergencies by arrangement; emergency phone 0171 5254095
entries.quote: in dringenden Fällen erreichen Sie uns über das Notfalltelefon unter 0171 / 5254095
entries.note: East Frisian island; dogs, cats, small pets.

entries.name: Tierarztpraxis Dr. Karl-Ludwig Solaro – Borkum
entries.duty: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 9–11, Thu also 16–18:30; closed Wed, Sat, Sun
entries.note: East Frisian island branch of the Norderney practice.

entries.name: Tierarztpraxis Puvogel – Bergen auf Rügen
entries.duty: Appointments Mon–Fri 8:30–18, Sat 9–13; small-animal emergency service Mon–Fri 18–22 on 03838 23323; after 22:00 and weekends 01805 84 37 36
entries.note: Second site in Schaprode (Streu 6, 18569 Schaprode, 038309 22836); 24-h readiness there is for horses and farm animals only.

entries.name: Tierarztpraxis Dittberner
entries.quote: Unser praxiseigener Notdienst ist ein zusätzlicher Service und nicht täglich oder rund um die Uhr verfügbar.
entries.note: Dogs, cats, small pets. Company holiday Oct–6 Nov 2026 with only a few open days.

entries.name: Tierarztpraxis Marie-Luise Maack
entries.duty: Appointments Mon–Thu 8–12 (Wed also 13–15), Fri 8–10; small-animal emergencies via 01805 84 37 36
entries.note: Page currently shows the practice as closed and names a substitute in Heringsdorf (see next entry).

entries.name: Tierarztpraxis DVM A. Huhn
entries.duty: Open consultations Mon 10–12 and 16–18, Tue 16–18, Wed 10–12, Thu 10–12 and 16–18, Fri 10–12
entries.note: Listed as substitute practice on Tierarztpraxis Maack's page; own website not found.

entries.name: Tierärztliche Praxis Janine Bahr-van Gemmert
entries.note: Island practice linked with Tierhuus/Robbenzentrum Föhr; the same number is described as '24 h in Notfällen erreichbar' for the Tierhuus and seal centre, not explicitly for the practice, so not marked 24 h. No opening hours given.

entries.name: Tierarztpraxis Dr. med. vet. Wolfram Gebhardt
entries.duty: Large and small animals, X-ray, house visits possible
entries.quote: 24 Stunden Notdienst nach telefonischer Absprache
entries.note: From the municipality of St. Peter-Ording's page; no phone or address given there (practice website not opened).

entries.name: Tiermedizin am Kurpark
entries.duty: Small-animal practice, appointments Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 9–13 and 15–18, Wed 9–12; emergencies: SH 24-h line 0481 85823998

entries.name: Giftinformationszentrum-Nord (GIZ-Nord), Göttingen
entries.duty: Poison information centre for Niedersachsen, Bremen, Hamburg and Schleswig-Holstein; 24-h phone advice
entries.quote: Besondere Erfahrungen bei der Beratung von Tiervergiftungen hat das GIZ Nord in Göttingen
entries.note: Animal coverage per Deutsches Tierärzteblatt 3/2015 (BfR article): all eight German GIZ advise 'aber auch bei Tiervergiftungen', 'sieben Tage in der Woche rund um die Uhr'. Phone, 24-h wording ('täglich rund um die Uhr') and states served from UMG press release on the 2020 annual report. GIZ-Nord's own site could not be fetched (robots/client error).

entries.name: Gemeinsames Giftinformationszentrum (GGIZ) Erfurt – Giftnotruf Erfurt
entries.quote: In der täglichen Beratungspraxis des Giftnotrufes Erfurt spielen nicht nur Vergiftungen beim Menschen, sondern auch bei Haus- und Nutztieren eine wichtige Rolle
entries.note: Own article on animal poisonings (statistics 1994–2008 incl. 1106 dogs, 304 cats). Number as in the site title 'Giftnotruf Erfurt 0361-730730' (footer: 0361 73073-0). Hours not stated on the fetched page, so not marked 24 h; ggiz-erfurt.de now redirects to a Helios page that could not be fetched.

entries.name: Kleintierklinik der LMU München
entries.duty: Emergency service weekdays 18:00-08:00, Fri 18:00-Mon 08:00 and all public holidays; come directly, the emergency team is not reachable by phone. Dogs and cats only; currently no dental or eye emergencies.
entries.quote: 24 Stunden am Tag, 7 Tage die Woche
entries.note: University small-animal clinic. Phone is the general line (Mon-Fri 7:30-16:30). Emergency flat fee 50 EUR + VAT, at least 2x GOT; payment immediately.

entries.name: Klinik für Kleintiere — Justus-Liebig-Universität Gießen
entries.duty: Urgent and life-threatening emergencies at any time of day or night; please phone ahead. Out-of-hours lines: Innere Medizin +49 151 55027008, Chirurgie +49 175 2973717.
entries.quote: Mindestens zwei ausgebildete Tierärzte sind rund um die Uhr im Haus, um die stationären Patienten und Notfälle zu betreuen.
entries.note: University small-animal clinic. Emergency flat fee 50 EUR net, at least 2x GOT. Birds/reptiles/fish: separate clinic, +49 641 9938666 Mon-Fri 8-16:30. Innere Medizin page also: 'den Service eines 24-stündigen Notdienstes'.

entries.name: Tierärztliche Klinik Oberhaching
entries.duty: Notdienst from 20:00 Mon-Fri and all day Sat, Sun and public holidays; same number for the 24-h emergency service.
entries.quote: 24-Stunden-Notfalldienst
entries.note: Emergency surcharge: up to 4x GOT outside consultation hours plus 60 EUR + VAT flat fee. Address from https://tierklinik-oberhaching.de/kontakt-anfahrt/.

entries.name: Tierklinik Ismaning — Fachklinik für Kleintiere
entries.duty: 24-h emergency staffing and surgery readiness, including weekends; regular hours Mon-Fri 8-20 by appointment.
entries.quote: 24 Stunden Notfallbesetzung und OP-Bereitschaft

entries.name: AniCura Tierklinik Haar
entries.duty: 24/7 emergency service for life-threatening emergencies; emergency hours 'Jeden Tag 00 - 24'.
entries.quote: 24/7-Notdienst

entries.name: Tierärztliche Klinik für Kleintiere Dres. Lutz (München-Riem)
entries.duty: Listed by the Tierärztlicher Bezirksverband Oberbayern as a München clinic with daily 24-h emergency service; not confirmed on the clinic's own site — phone first.

entries.name: Vet Zentrum Köln — Tierärztliche Klinik für Kleintiere

entries.name: Tierklinik Köln-Süd
entries.duty: 24/7 emergency service; call ahead if possible, in acute cases come directly. Regular: Mon/Wed/Fri 7-21, Tue/Thu 7-19. General line +49 221 4745430.
entries.quote: 24/7 Notdienst erreichbar
entries.note: Footer also names 'Tierklinik Kellerwessel in Köln'. Emergency surcharges per GOT.

entries.name: AniCura Tierklinik Neandertal
entries.duty: 24/7 emergency service for life-threatening emergencies; phone is NOT staffed during emergency service; patients triaged by urgency. Appointments by phone Mon-Fri 8-19.
entries.quote: 24 Stunden am Tag das ganze Jahr über
entries.note: Near Düsseldorf / Wuppertal (Kreis Mettmann).

entries.name: AniCura Bökelberg
entries.duty: 24-h emergency service; vet and veterinary nurse on site 365 days a year; emergency hours 'Jeden Tag 00 - 24'.
entries.quote: Für Notfälle besteht ein 24h - Notdienst.

entries.duty: Emergency service around the clock; regular hours Mon-Fri 8-18; emergency fees outside opening hours.
entries.quote: Notdienst rund um die Uhr

entries.name: Tierklinik Kalbach — Fachklinik für Kleintiere

entries.quote: Für lebensbedrohliche Notfälle stehen wir rund um die Uhr an 365 Tagen im Jahr zur Verfügung.

entries.name: Kleintierklinik Frankfurt-Bockenheim (AniCura)

notes:
North/east: North/east Germany (Berlin, Hamburg, Bremen, NI, SH, MV, BB, SN, ST, TH). Statewide/central lines: Sachsen, Brandenburg and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern all use 01805 84 37 36 (charged; connects to nearest duty practice); Schleswig-Holstein 0481 85823998 (chamber-organised 24-h service); Thüringen 0361 644 788 08 (as printed by Tierklinik Erfurt); Sachsen-Anhalt online search tieraerztliche-notdienste.de (no phone). City rotas: Berlin (chamber list, no central number), Hamburg 040 434379, Bremen 0421 438167, Hannover, Langenhagen area, Oldenburg, Osnabrück (24/7 mobile), Cuxland/Bremerhaven, Göttingen. Universities: TiHo Hannover small-animal clinic is 24 h for critical emergencies; FU Berlin ended 24-h small-animal care in 2022 (now 8–18 / 10–18); Uni Leipzig Klinik für Kleintiere page is blocked by robots.txt (not added; aggregator claims 24/7 unverified, 2023 news said emergency reception reduced to Mon–Fri 7:30–15:00). Poison lines: Deutsches Tierärzteblatt 3/2015 (BfR) states all eight German GIZ also advise on animal poisonings and singles out GIZ-Nord Göttingen; GGIZ Erfurt's own article says pet and farm-animal poisonings are an important part of its work -> both added as poison_line. Giftnotruf Berlin (Charité) services page mentions only humans (patients, companies, hospitals) -> not added. No 24-h clinic confirmed inside Hamburg city, Bremen city, Kiel, Lübeck, Dresden, Erfurt, Potsdam (AniCura Potsdam now 8–20) or Braunschweig; nearest confirmed 24-h: Norderstedt/Quickborn (Hamburg), Posthausen/Sottrum (Bremen), Wasbek (Kiel/Neumünster), Panitzsch (Leipzig), Lüneburg. Leftover / not researched: Schwerin, Chemnitz, Magdeburg, Halle, Jena, Osnabrück clinics, Göttingen clinics, Leipzig city clinics (Tierärztliche Notfallambulanz Leipzig site returned server error), Warnemünde (covered by Tierklinik Rostock), Harz, Fehmarn practices (only SH line found), Amrum (amrum.de not fetchable), Juist, Hamburg AniCura/other city clinics, Kleintierklinik Bremen. Unreachable/blocked: vetnotdienst.de and tieraerztekammer-berlin.de sub-page (tool provenance), ltk-brandenburg.de new emergency model page (client error x2), tknds.de 'Schnelle Hilfe' (client error), Tierärztekammer Schleswig-Holstein Kleintiernotdienst page (redirects to login), ltkt.de (Thüringen chamber), tierarzt-notdienst-hannover.de (redirect loop), kleintierklinik.uni-leipzig.de (robots), drbindernagel.de (robots), giz-nord.de (robots/client error), tierarzt-usedom.net (redirect loop), tierklinik-neustadt.de Kiel page, notfalltierarzt-leipzig.de (server error). Berlin 24-h entries rely on the Tierärztekammer Berlin list heading only (no hours per clinic) – verifier should open each clinic's own site.

West/south: West/south Germany (NW, HE, RP, SL, BW, BY). 31 clinics (19 with explicit 24-h wording) and 20 duty rotas. Not found / leftover: Düsseldorf city (chamber: no published rota; tierklinikduesseldorf.de returned a bot-check page); Nürnberg Tierklinik am Hafen (robots.txt disallows fetching, tieraerztlicheklinik-nuernberg.de); Tierklinik am Kaiserberg Duisburg (24/7 per an AniCura weekend list only, no own site found); Bochum, Gelsenkirchen (not in TAK-WL finder); Mainz, Wiesbaden, Darmstadt, Koblenz (no clinic page found); Hessen has no public rota (LTK Hessen page); Rheinland-Pfalz rota site notdienst-rheinland-pfalz.de, LTK Hessen calendar, ring sites (koelner-tieraerztenotdienst.de, tiernotdienst-dortmund.de, tier-not-dienst.de, tiernotdienst-rhein-neckar.de), kleintierklinik-frank.de (Freiburg), anicura.de/standorte/tierklinik-frankfurt/ and the LMU German contact page could not be opened (fetch tool provenance block, not a site refusal). Freiburg: lpt BW has no rota data; clinics Kleintierklinik Frank (+49 761 5036660) and Kleintierzentrum Landwasser (+49 761 16808) listed there without 24-h claim — not added. Konstanz: rota announced on practice answering machines only (sanfte-kleintiermedizin.de failed). Tierklinik Kaufungen (Kassel) says 24-Stunden-Service but appears equine-focused — not added. Holiday areas not covered: Oberstdorf, Tegernsee, Chiemsee (except Rosenheim), Lindau, Schwarzwald (except Villingen mentioned by lpt), Mosel (except Trier), Rhein valley. Augsburg, Mannheim, Heidelberg, Karlsruhe city, Bonn, Münster, Bielefeld, Dortmund, Wiesbaden: no 24-h clinic page opened. Entries citing a third-party page for 24 h (Dres. Lutz via TBV; Bockenheim via MainVet) need the independent check.
